# List.Times

```m
List.Times(start as time, count as number, step as duration) as list
```

Generates a list of time values given an initial value, count, and incremental duration value.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/list-times)
